facts.fact: IFC's description of its 2025 $100M facility states that Raxio operates carrier-neutral colocation data centres in Cote d'Ivoire (no facility named; date is the document's published year 2025).

IFC's description states that Raxio operates carrier-neutral Tier III data centres in Cote d'Ivoire, among seven countries; operator-stated Tier III, no facility named (date is the document's published year 2025).
